description: Split command matching removes quoted text before evaluating pipe and ampersand separated command segments.

input.command: echo 'rm -rf /' && rm -i safe | curl http://example && echo "wget http://quoted" && wget https://real

cases.expected_output:
original_command=echo 'rm -rf /' && rm -i safe | curl http://example && echo "wget http://quoted" && wget https://real
evaluated_command=echo  && rm -i safe | curl http://example && echo  && wget https://real
match_count=3
match_group=remove
match_description=unquoted rm
match_group=curl-start
match_description=pipe segment starts curl
match_group=wget-regex
